# Sri Pavan Tej Balam

> Portfolio of Sri Pavan Tej Balam — software developer, entrepreneur, and Co-Founder of Editco Media.

## About

Sri Pavan Tej Balam is a software developer and entrepreneur based in Hyderabad, Telangana, India. He builds full-stack products, AI automations, and digital brands. He is currently an SDE Intern at NxtWave and Co-Founder of Editco Media, a creative agency and digital-product studio.

He is pursuing a Computer Science program specializing in Data Science and Machine Learning at NxtWave Institute of Advanced Technologies (NIAT).

## Projects

### Agency ERP
- Description: A unified ERP platform for Editco Media to manage clients, projects, teams, finances, creative workflows, credentials, and agency operations from one dashboard.
- Technologies: React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, REST APIs
- Link: https://sripavantejb.editcomedia.com/projects/agency-erp
- Live: https://editcomedia.com

### WeA — n8n Automation Suite
- Description: Automation platform for freelancers and creative agencies — client outreach, invoicing, agent management, and AI content creation. National finalist at OpenAI × NxtWave Buildathon.
- Technologies: n8n, GenAI
- Context: OpenAI × NxtWave Buildathon — Finalist (Nationals), Nov 2025

### Voice-First AI Call Agent + Clinic CRM
- Description: Commercial AI product for Editco Media. Answers patient calls in real time, books appointments, stores patient data, generates insights, and handles payments.
- Technologies: Real-time voice AI, CRM, payments
- Result: Pitched to 2 clinics, both converted — ₹50,000+ in 48 hours

### ISMIGS — State Macro Intelligence System
- Description: Unifies coal, energy, and macroeconomic indicators into one framework with AI crop insights, yield forecasting, and auto-published reports. Top 10 nationally at OpenAI × NxtWave × IndiaAI Buildathon, Delhi.
- Technologies: Predictive models, unified data framework, publishing API

### AI Crop Doctor
- Description: Voice-first AI assistant for Telugu-speaking farmers with crop disease detection, weather, analytics, expert calls, and loan estimation. Built for Build for Telangana Hackathon.
- Technologies: React, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Supabase, Firebase, AWS S3, Google Speech, Hugging Face

## EditCo Media

Sri Pavan Tej Balam is Co-Founder of Editco Media (https://editcomedia.com), a creative agency and digital-product studio. He contributes to content creation, community engagement, branding strategy, MERN stack development, and graphic design. Editco Media has driven ₹15,57,800+ in cumulative agency revenue. Key product work includes Agency ERP and a Voice-First AI Call Agent + Clinic CRM.
